title: PitCrew Manager Observed State
description: Credential-free operational status projected by one PitCrew profile manager.

resourcePolicy.$comment: Manager and dashboard validators enforce memorySwapBytes >= memoryBytes.

lastExitDiagnostic.$comment: Classification precedence is Docker-confirmed OOM, SIGKILL, other signal, clean zero, ordinary nonzero error, launch failure, then unknown. Exit code 137 alone never proves OOM.

currentJob.$comment: Autoscaled job context is bounded lifecycle metadata from GitHub's scale-set listener. It excludes runner identity, workflow refs, labels, payloads, logs, environment values, and credentials.

hostPressureTelemetry.$comment: Pressure describes the Docker engine host or VM visible through the manager-only read-only host-proc mount. It is not necessarily the physical machine on Docker Desktop.

hostAdmissionAccounting.$comment: heldUnits equals activeUnits plus provisionalUnits. borrowedUnits equals max(heldUnits - reservedUnits, 0): shared capacity held beyond this profile's own reservation. withheldUnits equals max(pendingUnits - heldUnits, 0): demand this profile has not yet been granted.

hostAdmissionDecision.$comment: failureCategory is a bounded classification (for example coordinator-outage, budget-denied, profile-policy-mismatch). It never carries raw errors, host names, runner names, container IDs, paths, URLs, job output, or credentials.

hostAdmissionState.$comment: hostAdmission never infers physical CPU or memory. disabled and unavailable statuses report null (never a fabricated zero) for every measured field; unavailable still reports the configured namespace because it is policy, not a measurement.

sanitizedEvidence.$comment: Short operator-facing explanation. The character set excludes ':', '/', '@', '?', '=', and '&' so URLs, tokens, headers, and raw command output cannot be relayed.

managerEventOperation.$comment: Closed vocabulary. Managers must not invent operation names; a new operation requires a new manager contract version.

target.$comment: Slot key or autoscaling target key that already appears in non-secret observed state. No container identity, URL, or free-form identifier.

durationMilliseconds.$comment: null means the manager did not measure the operation; 0 means it measured a sub-millisecond operation.

managerEvent.$comment: Dashboards deduplicate on profileId plus sequence. Sequence is durable and monotonic across manager restart and hot-swap, so managerInstanceId identifies the observer rather than the identity of the event.

status.$comment: current means the retained window is intact, truncated means older or rejected entries were discarded, unavailable means the manager could not read or restore its journal.

managerOperationJournal.$comment: The journal retains failures, state transitions, retries, and recovery rather than every reconciliation pass. An empty events array with status current means no notable event has occurred. Malformed or oversized persisted entries are discarded into droppedEvents; the rest of observed state stays valid. Serialized journal size is capped at 16384 bytes.

subsystemHealthSummary.$comment: These summaries describe operations this manager performed. They never claim that the host, Docker daemon, network, or GitHub service as a whole is healthy.

capacityDeficitReason.$comment: Observed manager state, not a diagnosis inferred by a dashboard. A configured autoscaling maximum is not a health target and never creates a deficit by itself.

targetSlots.$comment: desiredSlots for fixed profiles and the activation targetSlots for an autoscaling target. It is never the configured maximum.

eligibleWorkers.$comment: GitHub-registered or scale-set-eligible evidence. null means the manager has no current control-plane evidence; 0 means it observed none.

fixed.$comment: null for an autoscaled profile, which reports per-target evidence instead.

then.$comment: Contract 14 publishes only a SHA-256 correlation key for the exact runner name. Raw runner and container identities remain private.

allOf.$comment: Contract 15 publishes bounded active GitHub Actions job context for autoscaled workers. Fixed, idle, and unattributed workers publish currentJob as null.
Fixed-manager job identity is unavailable because fixed runners have no scale-set lifecycle event.
Contract 16 publishes Docker-host or VM pressure from the manager-only read-only host-proc mount.

Contract 18 requires a complete, explicit hostAdmission object from both fixed and autoscaled managers. Contract 17 and earlier readers accept the field missing entirely; disabled profiles still publish every field, using null only for values that were never measured.

then.$comment: eligibleSlots equals the number of slots whose registrationStatus is connected; enforced by manager and dashboard validators.
Local worker counts and timestamped GitHub scale-set statistics are separate evidence. Neither source makes a mismatched runner automatically removable.

Contract 12 adds durable operation evidence. The journal, subsystem summaries, and capacity evidence are additive and nullable for contract 11 and older observations, so contract-10 and contract-11 readers are unaffected.
